ABOUT MOTO
What is Moto?

Moto is infrastructure for how you move.At home, abroad, and

everywhere in between, Moto gives its members a quieter way to

move through the world. It starts with a Visa Infinite card built for

global spending, with zero FX fees and one system that works

wherever you go. Beyond the card, Moto connects members to

preferred stays, dining, travel, culture, experiences, and wellness.

The card is only the beginning.

Moto is infrastructure for how you move.At home, abroad, and everywhere in between, Moto gives its members a quieter way to move through the world. It starts with a Visa Infinite card built for global spending, with zero FX fees and one system that works wherever you go. Beyond the card, Moto connects members to preferred stays, dining, travel, culture, experiences, and wellness. The card is only the beginning.

How does Moto work?

Moto combines a Visa Infinite credit card and a self-custodial

wallet into a single app. Deposit funds, receive a collateral-backed

credit limit, and use your card anywhere Visa is accepted. Moto

does not deduct each purchase from your balance like a debit

card. You spend on credit and settle your balance monthly. The

infrastructure is built onchain. The experience is designed to feel

like a premium card.

No. Moto is built for both mainstream and crypto-native members.

COSTS & BENEFITS
What does Moto Membership cost?

Moto Membership costs $2,500 per year or $250 per month.

Annual membership includes two months complimentary.

Moto Membership costs $2,500 per year or $250 per month.  Annual membership includes two months complimentary.

What does Moto Membership include?

Moto Membership is designed to make every part of spending

more valuable.



Members earn points on every dollar spent: 1x points on all

purchases, 3x on dining and retail, and 5x on travel. Points can be

redeemed for flights, hotels, or up to $200 per month in statement

credits. More airline and hotel programs will be added by the end

of the year. 1 point = 0.01 dollars.



Membership also includes zero FX fees, zero transfer fees,

unlimited access to airport lounges, and a dedicated Relationship

Manager available whenever you need assistance.Beyond the

card, Moto Lens gives members our global curation of

restaurants, hotels, shops, and bars. Moto Spaces, our dedicated

coworking and event spaces, are coming soon.

How can I apply for Moto Membership?

Applications are open on the Moto website and reviewed

periodically. If your application is approved, you’ll receive an email

with the next steps. To apply for Moto, simply download Moto from

the App Store or Play Store and begin your application.

How do I fund my Moto account?

You can fund your account with fiat or digital assets like USDC.

Moto offers Virtual IBANs for EUR transfers. For crypto deposits,

Moto provides the correct address for each supported asset and

network. Always confirm that the asset, network, and destination

address match the details shown in your account. Transactions

confirmed onchain cannot be reversed.

Why is my transaction under review?

Some transactions require an additional security or compliance

review. These checks help protect Moto members and the

integrity of the platform. Most reviews are completed within 24

hours. If your transaction has remained under review for longer,

contact Moto Support, and we’ll look into it.

How does identity verification work?

Every Moto member must complete identity verification during

onboarding. This helps us meet our regulatory obligations and

keep the platform secure. Depending on your jurisdiction or

account activity, we may occasionally require additional

information. If we do, you’ll receive clear instructions in the Moto

app.

What happens if I send funds to the wrong address?

Onchain transactions are irreversible. Funds sent to an incorrect

address, unsupported asset, or unsupported network may not be

recoverable. Before confirming a transfer, verify the asset,

network, and deposit address against the details shown in your

Moto account. If you believe you made an error, contact Moto

Support immediately. We’ll review the transaction and explain any

available options, but recovery cannot be guaranteed.

How does Moto protect my account and personal information?

Moto uses multiple layers of security, including encrypted

communications, device-bound passkeys, multisignature wallet

infrastructure, and ongoing fraud monitoring. Moto is

self-custodial, meaning you retain control of your assets. You

should still protect your device and credentials, review transaction

details carefully, and never share verification codes or recovery

information. Moto Support will never ask for your passkey or

private recovery credentials.

What should I do if a payment is declined?

A payment can be declined because of:

Insufficient available credit
A merchant or transaction restriction
A security check
A payment-network issue
A temporary service interruption

Check your available credit and confirm that your card is active,

then try again. If the payment continues to fail, contact Moto

Support with the merchant name, transaction amount, and

approximate time of the attempt.
